name: Don't Eat the Cashier!
source:
Congratulations!

You've just landed a night shift at a gas station for minimum wage, which sounds pretty spooky on its own. But the visitors to this station have a few surprises in store for you.

Embark on this short but eventful adventure, meet chatty monsters, flirt with an insane creature, pet a werewolf, and try not to become someone's dinner. The plot branches depending on your relationships and your success at work. Discover all possible outcomes — from the romantic to the utterly nightmarish.

[From [url=https://miloff.itch.io/dont-eat-the-cashier]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜！

你刚刚在加油站以最低工资找到了夜班，这本身听起来就很可怕。但来到这个车站的游客会为你带来一些惊喜。

踏上这段短暂但多事的冒险，遇见健谈的怪物，与疯狂的生物调情，抚摸狼人，并尽量不要成为某人的晚餐。情节的分支取决于你的人际关系和你在工作中的成功。发现所有可能的结果——从浪漫到彻底的噩梦。

[来自[url=https://miloff.itch.io/dont-eat-the-cashier]itch.io[/url]]
